title: An early stablecoin? The Bank of Amsterdam and the governance of money
lineage: Historical research working paper hosted by De Nederlandsche Bank, drawing on earlier studies; not the original 1609 charter.

passages.note: Amsterdam municipality founded a public giro bank in 1609; it was modelled on Italian public deposit banks and was owned by the city.

file.method: Paraphrased notes of the passages inspected.
